notes.title: Japanese and Spanish localization is ready!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193171/795b48c3a82d8971889d467dac14453617d3f450.png[/img]

What's up, guys! We're back to bring you a full translation of the game in Japanese and Spanish!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193171/cb423be3dc343ac57947570ddd55c5860ab7ca2e.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193171/8d38422198e9f399fb010b44ff0c08ccf4375317.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193171/1918ea5e39bd704a47886a1785cbdeb4aa97ed0a.png[/img]

In addition to that, we've added something little short and extra in the game.

Also, if you haven't yet, check out this game's follow-up, Super Ledgehop: Double Laser, where you play as Mashiro's best friend, Chizuru.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/787070/Super_Ledgehop_Double_Laser/

Finally, don't forget that the $20 speedrun bounty is still up for grabs.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C3aOF7WDgDA

notes.title: Beat my speedrun and I'll give you 80 quarters!
notes.notes:
EDIT: Speedrun leaderboards are up! https://www.speedrun.com/thequartergame

That's $20 bucks that I'm willing to PayPal to you if you're the first to beat it! 
Too small? Sorry I bought too many donuts so you gotta forgive me for that. 
If you use a splitting program, just get a time faster than 4:53. If you'd rather not use a program, that's fine! You can still do it if the time shown at the end of the game is faster than 5:08.
Here is the speedrun if you need any reference on how to run this game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C3aOF7WDgDA
